Title: FruitQ: a new dataset of multiple fruit images for freshness evaluation
Authors: Olusola Abayomi-Alli, Robertas Damasevicius, Sanjay Misra
Methodology: CNN feature extraction with MobileNetV2 and ResNet50 backbones
Train_Test_Protocol: 70/15/15 train/val/test with 5-fold cross-validation
Evaluation_Metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score
Main_Numerical_Results: MobileNetV2: 94.8% accuracy; ResNet50: 96.1% accuracy on natural multi-stage decay
Limitations: Does not integrate in-transit sensor telemetry or routing decisions
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Direct benchmark comparator for AgriRoute vision module; provides natural-background validation target

Title: Fruit ripeness classification: A survey
Authors: Matteo Rizzo, Matteo Marcuzzo, Alessandro Zangari, Andrea Gasparetto, Andrea Albarelli
Dataset: Comprehensive survey of 64 published agricultural datasets
Methodology: Systematic comparative review of transfer learning, ViTs, and shallow ML
Train_Test_Protocol: Taxonomy of split strategies and evaluation protocols
Evaluation_Metrics: Reported test accuracy, inference speed, parameter footprint
Main_Numerical_Results: 85% of studies use CNN transfer learning; fine-tuning pre-trained ImageNet beats training from scratch by 6-12%
Limitations: Identifies severe lack of cross-dataset testing and near-duplicate split contamination
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Provides empirical justification for AgriRoute's transfer learning strategy and exposes common evaluation pitfalls

Title: Classification and identification of agricultural products based on improved MobileNetV2
Authors: Haiwei Chen, Guohui Zhou, Wei He
Methodology: MobileNetV2 with coordinate attention mechanism and focal loss
Train_Test_Protocol: 80/20 train/test split with stratified sampling
Evaluation_Metrics: Top-1 Accuracy, FLOPs, Inference Latency, Model Size
Main_Numerical_Results: Improved MobileNetV2 reached 95.42% accuracy with 2.8M parameters and 22ms latency on CPU
Limitations: Laboratory background; does not evaluate transport conditions or spoilage progression
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Serves as edge efficiency benchmark for AgriRoute's lightweight MobileNetV2 baseline

Title: Fruit Image Classification Model Based on MobileNetV2 with Deep Transfer Learning Technique
Authors: Yonis Gulzar
Methodology: MobileNetV2 transfer learning with modified classification head (GAP + Dense 256 + Dropout)
Train_Test_Protocol: 70/15/15 split with data augmentation (flips, rotations)
Evaluation_Metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, Confusion Matrix
Main_Numerical_Results: Overall accuracy of 96.7% on curated images; lowest per-class F1 on rotten banana (92.1%)
Limitations: Curated studio photos; failure to test on real-market lighting or farm conditions
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Directly mirrors AgriRoute's baseline CNN classification head design

Title: Fruit freshness detection based on multi-task convolutional neural network
Authors: Yinsheng Zhang, Xudong Yang, Yongbo Cheng
Methodology: Multi-task CNN simultaneously predicting fruit category and continuous freshness index
Train_Test_Protocol: 80/10/10 train/val/test with five-fold cross-validation
Evaluation_Metrics: Multi-task Accuracy, MAE on freshness index, Inference Latency
Main_Numerical_Results: Category accuracy: 97.1%; Freshness index MAE: 0.048; Latency: 31ms on GPU
Limitations: Requires controlled illumination kiosk; not designed for mobile smartphone capture
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Demonstrates feasibility of joint crop-identification and freshness grading in a single pass

Title: Dynamic risk-aware ant colony optimization for low-carbon routing in perishable food supply chains
Authors: Jiqiang Li, Cun-He Cheng, Byung Chul Choi
Dataset: Simulated cold-chain logistics network (30 customer nodes, 3 depots)
Methodology: Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) coupled with dynamic shelf-life decay penalty
Train_Test_Protocol: Simulation across 5 temperature-abuse disturbance scenarios
Evaluation_Metrics: Total transport cost, Cargo spoilage loss (%), Carbon emissions
Main_Numerical_Results: Dynamic rerouting reduces total cargo spoilage loss by 28.4% and delivery rejection by 34.2%
Limitations: Uses hypothetical decay parameters; lacks visual quality inputs or real IoT data integration
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Direct theoretical support for AgriRoute's dynamic rerouting objective under perishability

Title: Remaining Shelf-Life Estimation of Fresh Fruits and Vegetables During Transportation
Authors: Sharafat Ali, Fakhrul Alam, Khalid Mahmood Arif
Dataset: IoT cold-chain telemetry from commercial fruit transit shipments
Methodology: Multi-sensor data logger (temperature, humidity, CO2) paired with Arrhenius kinetics
Train_Test_Protocol: Trip-wise leave-one-out cross-validation
Evaluation_Metrics: MAE in remaining shelf life (days), RMSE, R2
Main_Numerical_Results: Arrhenius-coupled sensor model achieved MAE of 0.82 days across transit routes
Limitations: Does not incorporate visual pre-dispatch inspection; relies entirely on physical sensor hardware
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Provides empirical physiological parameters and decay curves for AgriRoute's sensor module

Title: Impact of product perishability on agri-food supply chains design
Authors: Ana Esteso, M. M. E. Alemany, Angel Ortiz
Dataset: Empirical citrus supply chain in Spain (harvest to retail mandis)
Methodology: Mixed-Integer Linear Programming (MILP) with non-linear perishability decay functions
Train_Test_Protocol: Scenario-based sensitivity analysis across transit duration and temperature
Evaluation_Metrics: Total supply chain cost, Percentage product waste, Farmer revenue
Main_Numerical_Results: Perishability-aware optimization prevents 18.6% waste compared to standard shortest-path dispatch
Limitations: Assumes deterministic fixed decay rate at dispatch; no camera or sensor feedback
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Demonstrates macro-economic value of perishability-aware dispatch for agricultural producers

Title: A fine tuned EfficientNet-B0 convolutional neural network for accurate and efficient classification of apple leaf diseases
Authors: Ali Hassan, Noora Shifa, Rachid Benlamri
Sample_Size: 3,642 images across healthy and diseased leaves
Methodology: EfficientNet-B0 with fine-tuned compound scaling and Swish activation
Train_Test_Protocol: 70/15/15 stratified train/val/test
Evaluation_Metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, Macro F1, FLOPs
Main_Numerical_Results: EfficientNet-B0 achieved 98.41% accuracy with 4.05M parameters and 0.39 GFLOPs
Limitations: Evaluated on leaf pathology rather than fruit flesh rot; studio backgrounds
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Empirical evidence justifying EfficientNet-B0 as a high-accuracy edge comparator to MobileNetV2

Title: Revolutionizing agriculture with artificial intelligence: plant disease detection methods, applications, and their limitations
Authors: Abbas Jafar, Nabila Bibi, Rizwan Ali Naqvi, et al.
Dataset: Meta-review of 120 agricultural vision papers across 15 crops
Methodology: Systematic survey of deep learning architectures, domain shifts, and field deployment bottlenecks
Train_Test_Protocol: Taxonomy of field failure modes across laboratory vs real-world datasets
Evaluation_Metrics: Generalization drop (%), Domain shift vulnerability, Lighting sensitivity
Main_Numerical_Results: Models trained on studio images drop 25-45% in F1 when evaluated on real-farm field imagery
Limitations: Identifies lack of open, multi-domain evaluation benchmarks in agriculture
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Direct justification for AgriRoute's cross-dataset validation and frank limitation disclosure

Title: A Data-Centric Review of Plant Disease Datasets: Taxonomy, Critical Analysis, Environmental Variability, and Implications for Precision Agriculture
Authors: Aamir Hilal, Shabir Ahmad Sofi, Neeraj Goel
Dataset: Audit of 35 publicly available agricultural vision datasets
Methodology: Forensic data-centric audit of duplicate images, burst frames, and background biases
Train_Test_Protocol: Perceptual hash (pHash) analysis and metadata group auditing
Evaluation_Metrics: Percentage duplicated images, Background bias correlation, Leakage rate
Main_Numerical_Results: Over 32% of popular agricultural datasets contain identical or near-duplicate images across train/test splits
Limitations: Highlights systematic over-reporting of model accuracy in agricultural AI
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Directly motivates AgriRoute's image-leakage detection skill and group-aware split hygiene

Title: Application of Convolutional Neural Networks and Recurrent Neural Networks in Food Safety
Authors: Haohan Ding, Haoke Hou, Long Wang, et al.
Dataset: Comprehensive survey of food quality inspection studies
Methodology: Review of hybrid CNN-RNN architectures for non-destructive visual and temporal food assessment
Train_Test_Protocol: Comparative synthesis of sensor integration and visual classification
Evaluation_Metrics: Classification accuracy, Prediction horizon, False positive rate
Main_Numerical_Results: Hybrid architectures outperform unimodal models by 8.4% on perishable shelf-life estimation
Limitations: Identifies RNN gradient instability and synthetic data misuse as major obstacles
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Directly supports AgriRoute's multi-modal thesis while warning against trivial synthetic sequences

Title: Neural network-based UAV thermal calibration and crop water stress assessment in an apple orchard
Authors: Sungjay Kim, Daeyoung Kim, Sang-Yeon Kim
Dataset: Thermal and RGB imagery from commercial apple orchard
Sample_Size: 1,200 flight images paired with weather station telemetry
Methodology: Deep neural network calibrated against physical atmospheric temperature and humidity sensors
Train_Test_Protocol: Temporal cross-validation across 4 harvest months
Evaluation_Metrics: Expected Calibration Error (ECE), RMSE, R2
Main_Numerical_Results: Temperature scaling reduced calibration error by 62% (ECE from 0.084 to 0.032)
Limitations: High equipment cost; requires drone flight telemetry
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Provides direct methodological precedent for applying temperature scaling to agricultural neural networks

Title: A shelf life prediction model of Actinidia arguta based on postharvest quality evaluation combined with fuzzy mathematics
Authors: Xiaoman Liang, Guanlin Qian, Song Pan
Dataset: Storage experiment on fresh kiwifruit at 0C, 4C, and 20C
Sample_Size: 360 fruit samples tested across 28 storage days
Methodology: Kinetic Arrhenius modeling coupled with sensory, hardness, and soluble solids (Brix) testing
Train_Test_Protocol: Longitudinal repeated-measures design across temperature regimes
Evaluation_Metrics: R2, RMSE, Relative Error (%)
Main_Numerical_Results: Arrhenius model predicted shelf life with R2 = 0.962 and average relative error < 7.5%
Limitations: Destructive laboratory testing required; cannot be performed on-the-fly by farmers
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Provides ground-truth biological foundation for Arrhenius shelf-life decay constants in AgriRoute

Title: Comparative Study of CNN and Vision Transformer (ViT) Models for Image Classification on the Fruits-360 Dataset
Authors: Janet Jomy, Tushar Khadangle, R.V. Siva Balan
Methodology: MobileNetV2, ResNet50, and Vision Transformer (ViT-B/16) comparison
Train_Test_Protocol: Standard train/test split with identical preprocessing
Evaluation_Metrics: Top-1 Accuracy, Inference Latency per image (ms), Memory footprint
Main_Numerical_Results: ResNet50: 97.4%; MobileNetV2: 95.8%; ViT: 98.1%; MobileNetV2 was 4.2x faster than ViT on CPU
Limitations: Conducted on clean white backgrounds; no test on field or degraded produce
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Empirical benchmark establishing latency and parameter footprint trade-offs for edge vision backbones

Title: Adaptability of deep learning: datasets and strategies in fruit classification
Authors: Yonis Gulzar, Zeynep Unal, Shahnawaz Ayoub
Methodology: Cross-dataset transferability analysis using MobileNetV2 and InceptionV3
Train_Test_Protocol: Trained on Dataset A, tested on Dataset B (zero-shot cross-dataset)
Evaluation_Metrics: Cross-domain Accuracy, Drop in Macro F1
Main_Numerical_Results: Models trained on Kaggle images experienced a 31.4% drop in F1 when tested on FIDS30 field images
Limitations: No domain adaptation or selective prediction applied
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Directly corroborates AgriRoute's findings on out-of-distribution domain degradation

Title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
Authors: Chuan Guo, Geoff Pleiss, Yu Sun, Kilian Q. Weinberger
Methodology: Post-hoc probability calibration: Temperature Scaling, Vector Scaling, Platt Scaling
Train_Test_Protocol: Validation split calibration with held-out test evaluation
Evaluation_Metrics: Expected Calibration Error (ECE), Maximum Calibration Error (MCE), NLL, Brier Score
Main_Numerical_Results: Temperature scaling reduced ECE by up to 80% without altering classification accuracy
Limitations: Evaluated on generic vision benchmarks; not previously formalized for post-harvest agricultural routing
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Seminal foundational reference establishing the mathematical definition and utility of ECE and Temperature Scaling

Title: MobileNetV2: Inverted Residuals and Linear Bottlenecks
Authors: Mark Sandler, Andrew Howard, Menglong Zhu, Andrey Zhmoginov, Liang-Chieh Chen
Methodology: Inverted residual blocks with linear bottlenecks and depthwise separable convolutions
Train_Test_Protocol: Standard ImageNet train/val protocol
Evaluation_Metrics: Top-1 Accuracy, Top-5 Accuracy, Multiply-Adds (MACs), Parameters
Main_Numerical_Results: 72.0% top-1 accuracy on ImageNet with 3.4M parameters and 300M MACs; 30-40% faster than MobileNetV1
Limitations: Reduced capacity for fine-grained localized lesion segmentation compared to heavy residual nets
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Seminal architecture paper establishing the theoretical design of AgriRoute's primary vision backbone

Title: EfficientNet: Rethinking Model Scaling for Convolutional Neural Networks
Authors: Mingxing Tan, Quoc V. Le
Methodology: Principled compound scaling of network depth, width, and resolution with neural architecture search
Train_Test_Protocol: Standard ImageNet protocol
Evaluation_Metrics: Top-1 Accuracy, FLOPs, Parameter count, Inference Latency
Main_Numerical_Results: EfficientNet-B0 matched ResNet50 accuracy (77.1%) with 5.7x fewer parameters and 9.4x fewer FLOPs
Limitations: Higher training memory footprint due to high-resolution feature maps
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Seminal architecture paper justifying EfficientNet-B0 as a critical modern benchmark comparator for AgriRoute

Title: Grad-CAM: Visual Explanations from Deep Networks via Gradient-Based Localization
Authors: Ramprasaath R. Selvaraju, Michael Cogswell, Abhishek Das, Ramakrishna Vedantam, Devi Parikh, Dhruv Batra
Methodology: Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping from penultimate convolutional feature maps
Train_Test_Protocol: Visual attribution on held-out test images
Evaluation_Metrics: Localization error, Pointing game accuracy, Human trust score
Main_Numerical_Results: Localizes salient discriminative image regions with zero retraining or architectural modification
Limitations: Bilinear upsampling yields coarse heatmaps for small localized lesions
Relationship_to_AgriRoute: Seminal interpretability paper establishing the mathematical formulation of AgriRoute's Grad-CAM audit
